column1:
Showers or thundershowers will occur, at several places in the sea areas off the coast extending from
Matara to Batticaloa via Hambantota and Pottuvil. Showers or thundershowers will occur at a few
places in the other sea areas around the island.
Winds will be South-easterly or variable in direction. Wind speed will be (20-30) kmph.

The sea areas around the island will be slight.
Temporarily strong gusty winds and very rough seas can be expected during thundershowers.
